values.note: Hamilton County residents pay $30 for an inland RV site and $35 for a waterfront one; everyone else $40 and $45. A lower county 'family pricing' rate ($20) is also posted. Tent sites $20-25 with utilities, $15-20 without, for residents and non-residents. Seniors (65+), veterans, military, first responders and teachers get 10% off, refunded at check-in on proof.

values.note: Booked on the county's Itinio site; one-night stays are allowed. Register at the Ranger Station (open 10 a.m.-5 p.m.) before setting up; after hours, go to the booked site and check in at 10 the next morning. Full refund 7+ days before arrival, 50% within 7 days, none on the day. Residency is not allowed.

note: Hamilton County park on peninsulas and a causeway in Chickamauga Lake north of Chattanooga, with a swimming beach, boat ramps, fishing piers and yurts. Waterfront sites ring the shore of each camping area. Alcohol is not allowed. --Claude
summary: Chester Frost Park: county pages read (itinio booking site behind a human-verification check, unread). Rates $30-35 resident / $40-45 non-resident + $2 fee, 10% senior/military; 228 sites, 50/30 A + water, no sewer, dump/showers/laundry/wifi, year-round, 1-14 nights. Lakefront KEPT on the map's 'RV Waterfront' sites (e.g. Smokemont 12-20 at the peninsula tip, pads ~0.7-0.9 m above summer pool). max_rig 65 unconfirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT: the county's 2023 park map marks 'RV Waterfront' sites around every shore (Smokemont 1-38, Eagles Point 82-101, Windy Hills/Wolf Creek/Buffalo Run on the far side).
